name: Shemida
overview: Shemida, also called Shemidah, is identified in Scripture as a son of Gilead and a descendant of Manasseh, the son of Joseph. The family of the Shemidaites is noted among the clans of Manasseh, emphasizing their place within the tribal structure of Israel. The genealogical record in 1 Chronicles lists the sons of Shemida, highlighting the continuation of his lineage and the significance of his family in the biblical narrative.
